title.narrative: Annual Output Results
Percentage of children with decreased vulnerability to malnutrition in the context of climate change

description.narrative: Assesses the change in child nutrition outcomes linked to climate-resilient food systems or improved access to resources.

title.narrative: Number of functioning climate monitoring networks and capacities to develop climate change projections and weather forecasts

description.narrative: Assesses the number of operational climate monitoring systems (e.g., weather stations) and institutional capacities established or strengthened to generate localized forecasts and climate projections.

title.narrative: Number of detailed national maps of flood- and drought-related risks on pastoralism, sorghum production, migration flows, and infrastructure produced and disseminated

description.narrative: Captures the production and dissemination of national-scale thematic maps that identify flood and drought risk hotspots in relation to key sectors such as agriculture, migration, and infrastructure.

title.narrative: Area of land managed for climate resilience (ha)

description.narrative: Captures the total land area (in hectares) under improved management practices aimed at enhancing climate resilience. This includes land with interventions such as soil conservation, agroforestry, sustainable agriculture, or water management.

title.narrative: Number of climate change Master’s Programmes in University of Juba

description.narrative: Counts the number of Master's-level academic programmes on climate change formally established at the University of Juba.

title.narrative: Number of water harvesting and supply infrastructure established in Terekeka and Kapoeta to provide water for livestock

description.narrative: Counts the number of functional water harvesting and supply systems (e.g., dams, boreholes) built or rehabilitated to meet household and livestock water needs in target locations.

title.narrative: Number of policies developed or revised that mainstream adaptation.

description.narrative: Counts the number of national, sub-national, or sectoral development plans, strategies, or policies that have integrated climate resilience measures as a result of project support.

title.narrative: Number of school kitchen gardens established to provide food and shade to 1000 pupils

description.narrative: Counts the number of school kitchen gardens established and maintained to provide fresh produce for school meals and shaded spaces for pupils.

title.narrative: Number of students registered for the PGD in Climate Change programmes

description.narrative: Counts the number of students officially enrolled in Postgraduate Diploma (PGD) programmes on climate change within the reporting period.

title.narrative: Number of automatic synoptic stations established Description:

description.narrative: Counts the number of synoptic (weather-observing) stations installed that meet World Meteorological Organization (WMO) standards for tracking climate data.

title.narrative: Number of staff trained to produce user-friendly, short-range forecasts

description.narrative: Counts the number of technical staff capacitated to translate climate data into accessible short-range forecasts for end-users.

title.narrative: Number of detailed local maps of flood- and drought-related risks on pastoralism, sorghum production, migration flows, and infrastructure produced and disseminated

description.narrative: Measures the development and distribution of localized risk maps to inform planning and community-based adaptation at the district or county level.

title.narrative: Number of automatic rainfall gauges (WMO standard) established

description.narrative: Measures the number of automated rainfall gauges set up for improved data collection and early warning systems.

title.narrative: Number of climate-resilient agricultural plans developed in Terekeka and Kapoeta based on seasonal forecasts.

description.narrative: Measures the number of degraded watershed sites in Terekeka that have undergone restoration activities (e.g., reforestation, soil stabilization, drainage improvement) aimed at reducing flood risks to local markets.

title.narrative: Number of degraded watershed areas restored to protect markets against floods in Terekeka

description.narrative: Measures the number of degraded watershed sites restored through activities like reforestation, erosion control, or drainage rehabilitation to reduce flood risk to markets.

title.narrative: Number of people (men and women) with improved knowledge of climate change effects and adaptation opportunities

description.narrative: Measures the number of individuals who demonstrate increased understanding of climate change impacts and possible adaptation solutions after participating in awareness or educational activities.

title.narrative: Number of people (men and women) with improved knowledge of climate change effects and adaptation opportunities

description.narrative: Measures the number of men and women who have demonstrated increased understanding of climate change impacts and possible adaptation strategies as a result of training, workshops, or campaigns.

title.narrative: Number of formal contact groups on climate change, energy, and environment established at the national level

description.narrative: Measures the number of officially recognized multi-stakeholder groups formed at the national level to coordinate actions on climate change, energy, and environment.

title.narrative: Number of participatory land use plans developed to demarcate off-grazing areas in Terekeka and Kapoeta produced and implemented by local authorities

description.narrative: Measures the number of participatory land use plans developed and officially implemented to protect grazing areas from degradation.

title.narrative: Number of primary school teachers trained on climate change impacts and adaptation opportunities

description.narrative: Measures the number of primary school teachers trained to understand climate change and adaptation strategies, enabling them to integrate these topics into teaching.

title.narrative: Number of post-graduate research-based curriculum on climate change developed

description.narrative: Measures the number of research-focused postgraduate curricula on climate change created, validated, and approved by relevant academic authorities.

title.narrative: Number of competitive small grants programmes for research on climate change adaptation in South Sudan

description.narrative: Measures the number of small grant schemes launched to fund research on climate change adaptation in South Sudan.

title.narrative: Number of individuals reached through awareness-raising campaigns on climate change impacts and adaptation opportunities
